description: CombModule (the filter section's comb model): routing of the module's inputs to its CombFilter(kMaxFeedbackSamples), and per-voice reset through getLocalProcessor. Inputs as at the filter module: midi_cutoff in semitones (cutoff 8..136 plus modulation), midi_blend_transpose 0..84, filter_cutoff_blend 0..2, resonance 0..1, style 0..9.
